info.name: PTO Tracker
info.summary: Comprehensive PTO and vacation tracking for teams
info.description:
Track and manage paid time off (PTO) with flexible policies, approval workflows, notifications, and calendar integration.
Features: - Flexible PTO policies (unlimited, accrual-based, fixed annual) - Request submission and manager approval workflow - Full notification system (in-app bell notifications for all events) - Automatic calendar event creation when PTO is approved - Admin UI for policy assignment per user - Access control (users without policies can't access app) - Approval history view for managers - Permission-based navigation (approvals tab only for managers) - Dark mode compatible - Multiple leave types (vacation, sick, personal) - Request cancellation before approval - Secure (SQL injection, XSS, CSRF protection)
info.author: JCR Labs
